title: Rohit Sharma Back as Mumbai Indians Captain? Real or Fake

segments.text: Rohit Sharma is Mumbai Indians captain again. Real or fake?
Welcome to Paravion X. Daily world news, and whether it's real or fake.

segments.sub: IPL 2024 · HARDIK PANDYA MADE CAPTAIN · ESPNCRICINFO, MINT
segments.text: Three years ago, Mumbai took the captaincy away from him, and handed it to Hardik Pandya.

segments.sub: 1/3 · MI UNDER HARDIK · ESPNCRICINFO, THE HINDU
segments.text: Fact one. Under Hardik, Mumbai finished last in 2024, lost Qualifier 2 in 2025, and slipped to ninth in 2026. But that's not the big part.

segments.sub: 2/3 · TO PUNJAB FOR ARSHDEEP · ₹18 CR EACH · IPLT20.COM
segments.text: Fact two. This month, Mumbai traded Hardik to Punjab Kings, for pacer Arshdeep Singh. Eighteen crore rupees each.

segments.claim: Rohit Sharma is MI captain for IPL 2027
segments.text: So, is Rohit back? Real. Mumbai Indians confirmed it on Friday.
Fact three. Rohit captained Mumbai in five IPL finals, and won every single one.

segments.sub: FAN THEORY · NOT CONFIRMED BY MI · MINT, CRICTRACKER
segments.text: And the hidden message? Mumbai announced it at exactly five forty-five p.m. Fans say that's five titles, plus his jersey number, forty-five. Mumbai hasn't confirmed that.

segments.q: Can Rohit win Mumbai a sixth title
segments.text: Can Rohit win Mumbai a sixth title? Yes or no? Comment below. Stay tuned for further updates, and subscribe to Paravion X for more.
